items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee discusses a third party ('he') playing with/supporting Louie Armstrong, but does not claim personal interaction with Armstrong himself.

ctx.x: Well, actually, when you listen to him with Louie Armstrong, I think what he did was very good. It suited Louie --
He had to fit. He was supporting Louie Armstrong.
Well, that's right. I mean, he really (inaudible).
